answer: Reputation decay works like tending a garden: an identity's trust score halves every few epochs unless it submits fresh work that random peer juries verify. A Sybil farm can't build a pearl of trust once and coast; each fake account becomes an island that withers unless the attacker pays real compute and grading-review costs every epoch for every identity, so upkeep scales linearly with fleet size while rewards stay capped per account.
